tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Screen and page canvas. Nightlight navy, sampled from the brand hero; Daylight is a cool near-white. Never pure black or pure white as a ground.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Tiles, suggestion cards, the message strip, sheets. Sits on surface with hairline, not shadow.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells behind a row of tiles, the keyboard tray, inset fields.

tokens.name: surface-brand-tint
tokens.usage: Selected tile, the chosen suggestion, the active style chip. Always with a 3px focus ring or a check, so selection never rests on tint alone.

tokens.name: indigo
tokens.usage: The glow in the corner of the Nightlight ground, sampled from the hero (top left). Decorative only: background washes and the cover. Never text, never a fill that must be seen (1.3:1 on surface).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy, labels, the spoken message, the 'Sel' of the wordmark. 16.5:1 on surface and 11.0:1 on surface-brand-tint (night); 16.6:1 and 15.5:1 (day).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, helper text, the style tag under a suggestion. 9.2:1 on surface and 6.2:1 on surface-brand-tint (night); 7.3:1 and 6.5:1 on surface-sunken (day).

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: The brand voice color as text: the 'vo' of the wordmark at night, links, quiet buttons, selected icons, style tags. 10.5:1 on surface (night), 7.1:1 (day). In Daylight it deepens so it can still be read.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Fill for the one primary action, Speak. The orb teal at night; deep teal by day. Put on-primary on it, never literal white at night.

tokens.name: primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of primary: brightens toward the glow at night, deepens to navy by day. on-primary stays legible on both (10.5:1, 17.9:1).

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary, primary-pressed and danger fills. Navy on the orb teal 7.3:1 at night; white on deep teal 7.7:1 by day. Mirrors the hero's white button with navy label.

tokens.name: orb
tokens.usage: The orb and the sound-bar mark, same in both themes so the logo never shifts. Logotype and graphic use only (2.3:1 on Daylight surface is exempt as a logo, too low for text).

tokens.name: orb-glow
tokens.usage: The highlight at the orb's upper left and the outer halo. Decorative only, never text.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Spoken, saved, confirmed. The brand teal, always with a check and the word (Spoken, Saved), so it never depends on hue against danger.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: The one alarm color: Help, Delete, the attention screen. Reserved so that red always means this. A warm coral rather than a hard red, to stay calm. Always with a word or icon. 8.1:1 on surface (night), 5.6:1 (day); on-primary on a danger fill 8.1:1 and 6.1:1.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers and card edges that carry no meaning (1.4:1 and 1.3:1). Use border-strong for any edge that identifies a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges that identify a control: the secondary button, inputs, unselected tiles in dense grids. 5.2:1 on surface and 4.5:1 on surface-raised (night); 4.3:1 and 4.6:1 (day). Meets 3:1 non-text contrast.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus and selected ring: solid 3px, 2px outside the element. 10.5:1 on surface at night, 7.1:1 by day. Never a color shift alone.

families.brand: "Lexend", "Lexend Deca", -apple-system, "SF Pro Display", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
families.sans: "Lexend", "Lexend Deca", -apple-system, "SF Pro Text", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: Reference only: the wordmark is artwork, not live type. 'Sel' in ink, the 'l' drawn as three sound bars, 'vo' in teal. Use the supplied logo file, never retype it.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Website hero and onboarding headlines, as in the hero. Semibold, tight tracking, ink on surface.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Selvo learns how you like to say things, so conversations with the world around you flow more easily.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a headline on the website. ink at 90% strength reads as the hero's soft white (#e7e7ea).

styles.name: message
styles.usage: The spoken message in the strip while composing. Regular weight: aphasia guidance avoids bold running text. Scales up to fill the screen in Show mode.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Category and sheet headings. Semibold is the heaviest weight inside the app.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Button and tile labels. iOS body size so Dynamic Type scales it; never below 14px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: I'm getting hungry. Could we find something good to eat?
styles.usage: Suggestions, descriptions, settings. 1.5 line spacing, the ratio adults with aphasia chose most often.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Attribution and helper text in ink-muted or teal. 14px is the floor; nothing smaller ships.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between stacked captions; inner padding of chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gutter between tiles. The minimum gap between any two touch targets.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, screen side margin.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections on a screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above and below the message strip; breathing room in onboarding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Website sections; the gap that separates Clear from Speak.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Absolute floor for any tappable element (Apple HIG default).

tokens.name: touch-tile
tokens.usage: Communication tile side at the default density.

tokens.name: touch-primary
tokens.usage: Height of Speak and other primary actions.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, tags, inline images.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Tiles, suggestion cards, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Sheets, the message strip, large photo cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips and the sound bars. The mark's bars are pills, so every button echoes them.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Only under the floating Speak bar and modal sheets.

tokens.name: glow-orb
tokens.usage: The halo around the orb on the website and the app icon splash. One glowing object per screen at most; never on controls.
